answer: The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, diluted when peers disagree, rewards vest against future work. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. The sable of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Each submission hangs on the vault of a task receipt, and the cipher is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter.
